intended_object: A recursion and induction principle for building data on games ("Conway recursion"): to define motive x, it is enough to define it given its values on all left and right options of x. Inferred from the docstring.
explanation: This is an elimination principle (a recursor) used as proof and definition infrastructure. It is not a mathematical object to be formalized. The docstring says it is rarely needed explicitly because the termination checker handles recursion automatically. The implementation is sound. It is well-founded recursion along the subposition relation, whose well-foundedness is proved in `subposition_wf`. The recursive calls are justified by `Subposition.of_mem_moves`, so it does give Conway induction/recursion on IGame. Since it is a technical device rather than a mathematical definition, the faithful / too narrow judgment does not apply.
